title: Empowering VLMs for Few-Shot Multimodal Time Series Classification via Tailored Agentic Reasoning

claim.summary: MarsTSC performs few-shot time-series classification by refining a class-discriminative knowledge bank without updating VLM parameters.

modules.name: Class-pair knowledge-bank refinement
modules.scope_reason: Generator/reflector/modifier updates explicitly target classification boundaries, feature usefulness and class labels.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "To dynamically refine the knowledge bank"

modules.name: Two-pass pseudo-label and deferred memory updates
modules.scope_reason: Test-time updates depend on agreement between classification passes and confidence tiers of class-specific knowledge.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "Refine on Pseudo Label."
